cards.label: Night work
cards.text: Whoever's sitting on this vein hasn't put a name to it, but the ground still belongs to someone. You case the approach twice. No obvious watchers. That's not the same as no watchers.
One way in. You commit or you don't.

choices.label: Go slow

on_caught.text: Something moves that shouldn't. You've been seen.

choices.result_text: You take it slow — weight off every floorboard, timing the dark between passes.

choices.label: Go fast

on_caught.text: Something moves that shouldn't. You've been seen.

choices.result_text: You go in fast. Hesitation is what gets people caught, or so you tell yourself.

cards.text: The vein's yours to deal with, however you got here.

choices.label: Claim it
choices.result_text: You take it outright. Word gets round fast — it always does — and the relationship with whoever ran this patch takes the hit that comes with being seen to do it.

choices.label: Loot and leave
choices.result_text: You take what you can carry and leave the rest where it stands. Someone else's problem, still.
